title: Universal closedness is invariant under isomorphism of morphisms
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a universally closed morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $\widetilde f:\widetilde X\to\widetilde S$ be a morphism and let $a:X\to\widetilde X$ and $b:S\to\widetilde S$ be isomorphisms satisfying $\widetilde f\circ a=b\circ f$. Then $\widetilde f$ is universally closed.
